purpose: Declare the external, non-owning current-events sources used by the public News surface. These feeds are reader views of third-party reporting and community links; they do not become project canon merely by appearing on the site.

sorting.rule: Newest first. No project-authored political, ideological or source-quality score is used to order stories.

providers.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
providers.provenance: Article titles, publication times, source domains and links are supplied by GDELT's index of external publishers.
providers.boundary: GDELT is an index/discovery layer. The linked publisher remains the source for the article.

providers.name: Hacker News Firebase API
providers.provenance: Titles, timestamps and outbound URLs are community-submitted Hacker News items.
providers.boundary: A Hacker News item is a community link, not independent journalistic verification.

providers.name: Spaceflight News API
providers.provenance: The API aggregates article metadata from spaceflight publishers and links to the original story.
providers.boundary: The aggregator is a discovery layer; claims should be evaluated at the linked publisher.

epistemic_boundary: Presence in a live feed establishes only that an external source or community item was indexed. It does not establish the truth, importance or project endorsement of the underlying claim.
